# Components, risks and controls

<a id="comp-001"></a>
## COMP-001 Axiom toolkit

Validates the canonical spec, builds the knowledge graph, answers bounded queries and packets, renders docs and diagrams, exports features and runs bound tests.

Boundary: tools/axiom: a local process reading and writing project files only

## Risks

<a id="risk-001"></a>
- **RISK-001 Markup injection through spec text**: asset spec text rendered into docs and exported features; threat a value adds a heading, link or acceptance item; impact a reader or a build factory trusts a forged obligation; severity high

## Controls

<a id="ctrl-001"></a>
- **CTRL-001 Escape and flatten every value**: Escape every value for its output context and flatten exported values to one line, then verify the eight-section structure before writing. Enforced at tools/axiom/docs.py and tools/axiom/views.py; verified by TEST-020, TEST-021 and TEST-023
